{"metadata":{"description":"把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）Put DeepSeek Harness in your pocket: run dsh web on your computer and access it synchronously by scanning a QR code on your phone (LAN + public network, real‑time screen mirroring)","id":"gh:1334962266","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-pocket","slug":"shaobeichen/dsh-pocket","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","mobile","qr","remote","tunnel"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：电脑上跑 dsh web，手机扫码即同步访问（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）Put DeepSeek Harness in your pocket: "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"run dsh web on your computer and access it synchronously by scanning a QR code on your phone (LAN + "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"public network, real‑time screen mirroring)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"DSH Pocket"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> 把 **DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋**：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫二维码就实时看到电脑上的同一个界面——人在外面也能用。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ 顺手留颗 Star，作者能高兴一整天  ·  行，给你一颗 Star"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 这是什么"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**你不在电脑前，也想用电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness。**"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## ✨ 特性"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 特性                    | 说明                                                                        "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"                                                                                                    "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"                                                                                                   |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| 📶 局域网扫码           | 装好即用：设置 → 手机访问，打开就有局域网二维码，手机连同一 WiFi 扫码即开（自动识别本机局域网 IP，**WSL 环境自动取 Windows 物理网"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"卡 IP**）                                         |
